title: Date Picker
text:
Docs Components Date Picker Date Picker A recipe: Popover + Calendar. Not a new component — there is no Ui::DatePickerComponent, you compose the parts yourself. Installation Shadwire follows shadcn/ui's open code model: the component's source is copied into your application and becomes yours. Install it with the CLI: Copyshadwire add date-picker --yes The date-picker registry item installs these files: app/components/ui_component.rb app/javascript/controllers/ui_date_picker_controller.js vendor/shadwire/shadwire.css This component uses Stimulus, so the application needs importmap-rails and stimulus-rails with automatic controller loading. Haven't installed the CLI yet? gem install shadwire, then shadwire init. Usage ui_calendar is what holds the value: it writes the chosen date into a hidden input (name:) e anuncia ui-calendar:change. O controller ui-date-picker ouve esse evento to write the formatted date into the trigger's label and close the popover — presentation, nothing more. Without it the picker still works; it just never tells the user what was chosen. ExpandCopy
<%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(variant: :outline, class: "w-[212px] justify-between font-normal") do %> Select uma data <%= ui_icon("chevron-down", class: "opacity-50") %> <% end %> <%= ui_popover_content(align: :start, class: "w-auto! p-0!") do %>
<%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(variant: :outline, class: "w-[212px] justify-between font-normal") do %> Select uma data <%= ui_icon("chevron-down", class: "opacity-50") %> <% end %> <%= ui_popover_content(align: :start, class: "w-auto! p-0!") do %> <%= ui_calendar(name: "due_on") %> <% end %> <% end %>
The popover needs w-auto! p-0!: the default is w-72 with padding, too narrow for the calendar grid. The ! goes at the end of the class — that is Tailwind v4 syntax. Composition Copydata-controller="ui-date-picker" the wiring: formats the label, parses what is typed, closes the popover `-- Popover |-- Popover::Trigger the visible field: a Button or an InputGroup | `-- [data-ui-date-picker-target="label" | "input"] `-- Popover::Content (w-auto! p-0!) `-- Calendar name:/end_name: write the value into the form Examples The eight arrangements shadcn/ui documents, translated into ViewComponent + Stimulus. Default A button that opens the calendar in a popover and then shows the chosen date. Pick a date ExpandCopy<%# Date Picker = Popover + Calendar (a recipe, not a new component). The ui-date-picker controller writes the chosen date into the label and closes the popover. %>
<%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(variant: :outline, class: "w-[212px] justify-between font-normal") do %> Pick a date <%# Date Picker = Popover + Calendar (a recipe, not a new component). The ui-date-picker controller writes the chosen date into the label and closes the popover. %>
<%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(variant: :outline, class: "w-[212px] justify-between font-normal") do %> Pick a date <%= ui_icon("chevron-down", class: "opacity-50") %> <% end %> <%= ui_popover_content(align: :start, class: "w-auto! p-0!") do %> <%= ui_calendar(name: "due_on") %> <% end %> <% end %>
With a label The same trigger inside a Field, tied to the label by id. Date Pick a date ExpandCopy<%# The trigger is an ordinary button, so `for:`/`id:` tie it to the field label. %> <%= ui_field(class: "w-48", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "checkin") { "Date" } %> <%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(id: "checkin", variant: :outline, class: "justify-start font-normal") do %> Pick a date <%# The trigger is an ordinary button, so `for:`/`id:` tie it to the field label. %> <%= ui_field(class: "w-48", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "checkin") { "Date" } %> <%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(id: "checkin", variant: :outline, class: "justify-start font-normal") do %> Pick a date <% end %> <%= ui_popover_content(align: :start, class: "w-auto! p-0!") do %> <%= ui_calendar(name: "checkin_on") %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> Range Two dates in a single trigger. The popover closes when the second end lands, not the first. Length of stay Pick the dates ExpandCopy<%# `mode: :range` records both ends: `name:` is the start, `end_name:` the finish. %> <%= ui_field(class: "w-72", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker", ui_date_picker_format_value: "medium" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "stay") { "Length of stay" } %> <%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(id: "stay", variant: :outline, class: "justify-start gap-2 px-2.5 font-normal") do %> <%= ui_icon("calendar", class: "opacity-50") %> Pick the dates<%# `mode: :range` records both ends: `name:` is the start, `end_name:` the finish. %> <%= ui_field(class: "w-72", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker", ui_date_picker_format_value: "medium" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "stay") { "Length of stay" } %> <%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(id: "stay", variant: :outline, class: "justify-start gap-2 px-2.5 font-normal") do %> <%= ui_icon("calendar", class: "opacity-50") %> Pick the dates <% end %> <%= ui_popover_content(align: :start, class: "w-auto! p-0!") do %> <%= ui_calendar( mode: :range, selected: Date.current..(Date.current + 20), number_of_months: 2, name: "stay[from]", end_name: "stay[to]" ) %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> Date of birth A caption with month and year selects and max: today — nobody was born next week. Date of birth Pick the date ExpandCopy<%# `caption_layout: :dropdown` swaps the month label for month and year selects — essential when the target is decades away. `max:` bounds the calendar and, with it, the range offered in the year select. %> <%= ui_field(class: "w-52", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker", ui_date_picker_format_value: "short" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "born-on") { "Date of birth" } %> <%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(id: "born-on", variant: :outline, class: "justify-between font-normal") do %> <%# `caption_layout: :dropdown` swaps the month label for month and year selects — essential when the target is decades away. `max:` bounds the calendar and, with it, the range offered in the year select. %> <%= ui_field(class: "w-52", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker", ui_date_picker_format_value: "short" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "born-on") { "Date of birth" } %> <%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(id: "born-on", variant: :outline, class: "justify-between font-normal") do %> Pick the date <%= ui_icon("chevron-down", class: "opacity-50") %> <% end %> <%= ui_popover_content(align: :start, class: "w-auto! p-0!") do %> <%= ui_calendar(name: "profile[born_on]", caption_layout: :dropdown, max: Date.current) %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> With a text field Type the date or pick it in the calendar: the text becomes a date and the date comes back formatted. ↓ opens the popover. Subscription date ExpandCopy<%# Text field + calendar: whatever is typed gets parsed and moves the calendar to that date; whatever is picked in the calendar comes back formatted into the field. ↓ in the field opens the popover. %> <%= ui_field(class: "w-60", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "subscribed-on") { "Subscription date" } %> <%= ui_input_group do %> <%= ui_input_group_input( id: "subscribed-on",<%# Text field + calendar: whatever is typed gets parsed and moves the calendar to that date; whatever is picked in the calendar comes back formatted into the field. ↓ in the field opens the popover. %> <%= ui_field(class: "w-60", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "subscribed-on") { "Subscription date" } %> <%= ui_input_group do %> <%= ui_input_group_input( id: "subscribed-on", placeholder: "June 1, 2026", autocomplete: "off", data: { ui_date_picker_target: "input" } ) %> <%= ui_input_group_addon(align: :inline_end) do %> <%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger( variant: :ghost, size: :icon, class: "size-6! rounded-sm", aria: { label: "Pick a date" } ) do %> <%= ui_icon("calendar", size: :sm) %> <% end %> <%= ui_popover_content(align: :end, class: "w-auto! p-0!") do %> <%= ui_calendar(name: "subscribed_on", selected: Date.current) %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> Date and time The picker settles the day; a native input type="time" settles the hour. Date Pick one Time ExpandCopy<%# Date and time are two fields: the picker settles the day, a native `input type="time"` settles the hour. The browser's own indicator is hidden so it does not compete with the field's icon. %>
<%= ui_field(data: { controller: "ui-date-picker" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "meeting-on") { "Date" } %> <%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(id: "meeting-on", variant: :outline, class: "w-36 justify-between font-normal") do %><%# Date and time are two fields: the picker settles the day, a native `input type="time"` settles the hour. The browser's own indicator is hidden so it does not compete with the field's icon. %>
<%= ui_field(data: { controller: "ui-date-picker" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "meeting-on") { "Date" } %> <%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(id: "meeting-on", variant: :outline, class: "w-36 justify-between font-normal") do %> Pick one <%= ui_icon("chevron-down", class: "opacity-50") %> <% end %> <%= ui_popover_content(align: :start, class: "w-auto! p-0!") do %> <%= ui_calendar(name: "meeting[on]", caption_layout: :dropdown) %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> <%= ui_field(class: "w-32") do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "meeting-at") { "Time" } %> <%= ui_input( type: :time, id: "meeting-at", name: "meeting[at]", step: 1, value: "10:30:00", class: "appearance-none bg-background [&::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator]:hidden" ) %> <% end %>
Natural language It takes "today", "tomorrow", "in 2 weeks", "next friday". The phrase table lives in the controller — it is your code. Schedule publication Your post goes out on . ExpandCopy<%# `natural_language_value: true` turns on the controller's relative vocabulary: "today", "tomorrow", "in 2 weeks", "next friday" — alongside the 08/01/2026, 2026-08-01 and "August 1, 2026" formats. The phrase table is your code: edit the controller to suit the language you publish in. %> <%= ui_field(class: "max-w-xs", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker", ui_date_picker_natural_language_value: "true" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "publish-on") { "Schedule publication" } %> <%= ui_input_group do %> <%= ui_input_group_input(<%# `natural_language_value: true` turns on the controller's relative vocabulary: "today", "tomorrow", "in 2 weeks", "next friday" — alongside the 08/01/2026, 2026-08-01 and "August 1, 2026" formats. The phrase table is your code: edit the controller to suit the language you publish in. %> <%= ui_field(class: "max-w-xs", data: { controller: "ui-date-picker", ui_date_picker_natural_language_value: "true" }) do %> <%= ui_field_label(for: "publish-on") { "Schedule publication" } %> <%= ui_input_group do %> <%= ui_input_group_input( id: "publish-on", value: "in 2 days", placeholder: "tomorrow or next friday", autocomplete: "off", data: { ui_date_picker_target: "input" } ) %> <%= ui_input_group_addon(align: :inline_end) do %> <%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger( variant: :ghost, size: :icon, class: "size-6! rounded-sm", aria: { label: "Pick a date" } ) do %> <%= ui_icon("calendar", size: :sm) %> <% end %> <%= ui_popover_content(align: :end, class: "w-auto! p-0!") do %> <%= ui_calendar(name: "post[publish_on]", caption_layout: :dropdown, selected: Date.current + 2) %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> <%= ui_field_description do %> Your post goes out on . <% end %> <% end %> RTL dir: :rtl mirrors the grid, the arrows and the ←/→ keys; month_names:/day_names: translate the caption. اختر تاريخًا ExpandCopy<%# `dir: :rtl` mirrors the grid, the navigation arrows and the ←/→ keys. `month_names:`/`day_names:` translate the caption and the column headers; `lang` and `locale-value` take care of the formatted date and the ARIA labels. %> <% month_names = %w[يناير فبراير مارس أبريل مايو يونيو يوليو أغسطس سبتمبر أكتوبر نوفمبر ديسمبر] %> <% day_names = %w[أحد إثنين ثلاثاء أربعاء خميس جمعة سبت] %>
<%= ui_popover do %><%# `dir: :rtl` mirrors the grid, the navigation arrows and the ←/→ keys. `month_names:`/`day_names:` translate the caption and the column headers; `lang` and `locale-value` take care of the formatted date and the ARIA labels. %> <% month_names = %w[يناير فبراير مارس أبريل مايو يونيو يوليو أغسطس سبتمبر أكتوبر نوفمبر ديسمبر] %> <% day_names = %w[أحد إثنين ثلاثاء أربعاء خميس جمعة سبت] %>
<%= ui_popover do %> <%= ui_popover_trigger(variant: :outline, class: "w-[212px] justify-between font-normal") do %> اختر تاريخًا <%= ui_icon("chevron-down", class: "opacity-50") %> <% end %> <%= ui_popover_content(align: :end, class: "w-auto! p-0!") do %> <%= ui_calendar(name: "rtl_date", dir: :rtl, month_names: month_names, day_names: day_names) %> <% end %> <% end %>
API reference What the calendar accepts is documented under Calendar. Below, only the wiring controller — data-* attributes on the element wrapping the popover and the field. Atributo Default Description format-value long full, long, medium, short or iso. locale-value — BCP 47 (pt-BR, ar-EG). Empty follows the browser's language. separator-value  –  What separates the two ends of a range in the label. date-order-value dmy How to read 01/06/2026 as you type. mdy for the US order. close-on-select-value true Closes the popover on selection. With mode: :range, only once the second date lands. natural-language-value false Accepts relative phrases (“tomorrow”, “in 2 weeks”, “next friday”) in the text field. target="label" — The element whose text becomes the chosen date; it gets data-empty while empty. target="input" — An editable text field: what you type is parsed, and ↓ opens the popover. target="preview" — An optional echo of the parsed date, for a supporting line below the field. <% end %> <%= ui_card_footer do %> <%= ui_button { "Save changes" } %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> <%= ui_tabs_content(value: :password) do %> <%= ui_card do %> <%= ui_card_header do %> <%= ui_card_title { "Password" } %> <%= ui_card_description { "Change your sign-in password here." } %> <% end %> <%= ui_card_content(class: "grid gap-4") do %>

<% end %> <%= ui_card_footer do %> <%= ui_button { "Save password" } %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> <% end %> Disabled trigger disabled: true removes the trigger from the keyboard flow and from activation. text: Docs Components Tooltip Tooltip A bubble showing information related to an element on hover or focus. Installation Shadwire follows shadcn/ui's open code model: the component's source is copied into your application and becomes yours. Install it with the CLI: Copyshadwire add tooltip --yes The tooltip registry item installs these files: app/components/ui_component.rb app/components/ui/tooltip_component.rb app/components/ui/tooltip/trigger_component.rb app/components/ui/tooltip/content_component.rb app/components/ui/button_component.rb app/helpers/ui/tooltip_helper.rb app/helpers/ui/button_helper.rb app/javascript/controllers/ui_tooltip_controller.js vendor/shadwire/shadwire.css This component uses Stimulus, so the application needs importmap-rails and stimulus-rails with automatic controller loading. Haven't installed the CLI yet? gem install shadwire, then shadwire init. Usage O controller ui-tooltip opens on hover or focus after a delay, ties the trigger to the bubble through aria-describedby, and closes on Esc without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13). The content lives inside the root, so the pointer can move onto it without closing it. Copy<%= ui_tooltip do %> <%= ui_tooltip_trigger(variant: :outline) { "Passe o mouse" } %> <%= ui_tooltip_content { "Add to library" } %> <% end %> Or render the components directly: Copy<%= render Ui::TooltipComponent.new(open_delay: 150) do %> <%= render Ui::Tooltip::TriggerComponent.new do %> Ajuda <% end %> <%= render Ui::Tooltip::ContentComponent.new(side: :right) do %> Mais detalhes <% end %> <% end %> Composition CopyTooltip (data-controller="ui-tooltip", relative) |-- Tooltip::Trigger (Button descrito via aria-describedby) `-- Tooltip::Content (role="tooltip", absolute, side:) Examples Default Opens on hover and on focus after a short delay; Esc closes it without moving focus. Passe o mouse Add to library Copy<%= ui_tooltip do %> <%= ui_tooltip_trigger(variant: :outline) { "Passe o mouse" } %> <%= ui_tooltip_content { "Add to library" } %> <% end %> Sides side: :top, :right, :bottom or :left positions the bubble.
